[[File:Cameron McMillan BoardMatt 2022-07-22 still.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Cameron McMillan. Still: BoardMatt.]]
'''Cameron McMillan''' (also published as '''Cameron MacMillan''') is a ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game collector. He is a panelist on [[BoardMatt]] market reports with [[Darth Grader]].<ref name="yt-O0Mc_Uw17_Y" /> He was a guest on Darth Grader's Super Collector video with [[Andy Talaga]].<ref name="yt-FaXwf_ZGREU" /> He has played in the [[Retro League]] on [[GEMP]].
